text: The figures show solid top‑line growth with revenue at 6,455 million and a 27.6 % annual compounding rate, while profitability is weaker, evidenced by a PAT decline of 28.4 % year‑on‑year and a margin falling to 15.8 % in Q2FY27. Thus, the numbers support the bullish narrative on revenue expansion but do not fully back the story of strong earnings performance.
